name: Loading state
purpose: Show that content is on its way without layout shift, flashing, or blocking the whole page.
whenToUse: Skeleton rows while a list or table loads and the shape of the content is known.
An inline spinner on a button or next to a field while a short action runs (Saving, Checking availability).
A progress bar when the amount is known (upload, export, import).
A single quiet loading line (Loading) inside a small panel when the shape is unknown.
whenNotToUse: Full-page spinners or blocking overlays. Keep the shell visible and load inside the region.
Loads that finish in under 200ms. Show nothing; a skeleton flash is worse than a short blank.
Indeterminate spinners for work whose progress you do know. Use determinate progress.
Skeletons that do not match the final layout, which cause shift when the data lands.
Decorative shimmer on content that is already present.
Announcing every refresh. Background refreshes should be silent.
anatomy: Skeleton row: same height as the real row (40px), a muted bar at a plausible width. Varying widths read as text, identical widths read as a loader.
Spinner: 14px ring, neutral track, inherits text colour. Sits left of the label; the label stays.
Progress: 4px track (--s3), neutral fill (--text-2), optional label with a tabular percentage.

variants.description: Rows of muted bars matching the final layout.
variants.useWhen: Lists, tables and cards that load from the server.

variants.description: Small spinner beside or inside a control.
variants.useWhen: Button and field level waits of a few seconds.
Uploads, exports and other measurable work.

behavior: Delay 200ms before showing any loading indicator; if the data arrives first, show nothing.
Once shown, keep the indicator for at least 400ms so it does not flicker.
Reserve the final height (min-height or matching row count) so nothing jumps when content arrives.
Buttons keep their label and width; the spinner replaces the icon and repeat clicks are ignored.
Never show a spinner inside a skeleton. One loading signal per region.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the shimmer stops and the skeleton is a flat surface; the spinner slows.
If loading fails, replace the loader with the error-loading empty state (see preset.empty-state).
accessibility: Set aria-busy="true" on the region being loaded and false when done; announce completion only when the user started the load.
Spinners are decorative (aria-hidden); the adjacent text says what is happening.
Progress uses role=progressbar with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin and aria-valuemax and a label.
Skeleton bars are not read out; the container carries the status.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion by removing the shimmer.
